comments.note: begin-work.ts: the 'claimed' variable is captured via closure from inside the updateWorkPackageWithSync callback. This works correctly (callback is awaited synchronously within the file lock), but the captured-closure pattern is non-obvious for future contributors. A brief inline comment explaining that 'claimed is written inside the lock and read after await' would reduce confusion.

begin-work.ts: Guard errors thrown inside the callback get re-wrapped by the outer catch as 'Error beginning work: Cannot begin work on WP-001: ...'. The double-prefixed message is redundant (e.g. 'Error beginning work: Cannot begin work on WP-001...'). Consider omitting the outer prefix so error messages are self-contained. Non-blocking polish.
